answer: The pigment cap is upheld at intake and beacon shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a delta tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 6 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
